mew.definition:
n. the common gull of Eurasia and northeastern North America
v. utter a high-pitched cry, as of seagulls
mew.translation:
n. 猫叫声, 海鸥
vi. 咪咪叫
n. 鹰笼, 巢, 隐匿处
vt. 关进笼子

mew gull.translation: [网络] 海鸥；可能系海鸥；喵鸥

mewa.translation: abbr. metal vapor vacuum arc 金属蒸气真空（电）弧; Motor and Equipment wholesalers Association 发电机和设备批发商协会

mewed.translation: v. 作猫或海鸟叫, 咪咪叫( mew的过去式和过去分词 )

mewing.definition:
v cry like a cat
v utter a high-pitched cry, as of seagulls
mewing.translation: v. 作猫或海鸟叫, 咪咪叫( mew的现在分词 )

mewl.translation: vi. 低泣, 低叫, 咪咪叫

mewled.translation: v. 啜泣( mewl的过去式和过去分词 )

mewling.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Mewl
mewling.translation: v. 啜泣( mewl的现在分词 )

mewls.translation: v. 啜泣( mewl的第三人称单数 )

mews.definition: n. street lined with buildings that were originally private stables but have been remodeled as dwellings
